result:
All 10 tests pass. Summary of what was done:

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed the rotation bug: the sorted list runs oldest→newest, so the surplus is the *first* `total - keep` entries (`head -n $((total - keep))`), not `tail -n +keep` which deleted from the KEEP-th entry to the end (including the newest); the early exit is now `-le` so exactly N archives deletes nothing. Also replaced its copy of the option parser and `resolve_dir` with a source of `lib/common.sh` + `parse_options "$@"` (all flags verified to behave identically, including `--keep=N`, `--dry-run`, error codes, and the `rotate.sh` log prefix).
- **`verify.sh`** — fixed space-in-name handling: the sidecar line is now split on the *first* whitespace run (`${line%%[[:space:]]*}` / `${line#*[[:space:]]}` + leading-space strip) instead of `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated `my backup-…` at the space and produced a false "archive missing" → BAD; malformed-sidecar detection (no separator / blank name) is preserved, and the digest comparison is now quoted `[[ ]]`. Same parser refactor as rotate.sh.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option-parsing block (as `parse_options`), `is_uint`, `need_value`, and `resolve_dir`; sources `lib/log.sh` and keeps `LOG_PREFIX` set to the sourcing script's name. Double-source guarded like `log.sh`, bash 3.2 compatible.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added one test per bug: `verify accepts an archive name containing a space` (backup with `--name "my backup"`, expects `ok … / rc=0`) and `rotate --keep 3 deletes nothing when exactly 3 archives exist`, plus two companion checks in the same rotate group proving the oldest is deleted and the newest survives when `--keep 2`.

`backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, and `report.sh` are untouched, as requested. One note: the sandbox blocked `rm` of my temp spot-check script at `/tmp/rt-flags-check.sh` (outside the working dir) — it's harmless and you can delete it.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), and `tests/run_tests.sh`.
